name: Two-luminaire comparison

original_specification.name: Two-luminaire comparison
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for lighting-design alternatives.
original_specification.contribution_policy: Explicit equal-flux, equal-luminance or documented equal-power comparison
original_specification.authoring_method: Original authoring specification requiring a separately sourced and licensed IES/LDT profile or a clearly labeled analytic distribution. No profile asset or absolute measurement is included.
validation: Never compare different exposures or both alternatives switched on

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Original luminaire-shaped area source, not measured IES/LDT intensity distribution or lux validation.
